| Platform | Download |
|---|---|
| Windows 10 / 11 | `freezetime-windows-x64.exe`, a single file with nothing to install |

**First launch.** The exe isn't code-signed, so at "Windows protected your PC" click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

**Setup.** Click **add the file**, then start CS2 (or restart it if it's open). The dot turns white when the first update arrives.
